items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith. Eagles RB room heavily impacted.
items.why: Friday final injury report from ETR
items.implication: Major RB/WR void in PHI offense vs JAX
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries for remaining backs like Shipley/Gainwell; more targets to Goedert/Wicks

items.text: Key QUESTIONABLE: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Rhamondre Stevenson, Rico Dowdle, Terry McLaurin, Carnell Tate, Alvin Kamara, Caleb Williams. IN also includes Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert.
items.why: Comprehensive ETR Friday/Sunday board; messy list flagged by Levitan
items.implication: Sunday morning chaos; monitor for ACTIVE/OUT flips and beneficiaries (e.g. Gesicki if CIN WRs out)

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons with ankle injury; Huntley expected to start. Also OUT: Trey Hendrickson, Cam Jurgens.
items.why: Official team/coach ruling corroborated by Schefter
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded significantly; Huntley start
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely and Zay Flowers (if active) see more volume; Henry workload stable or up

items.text: Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants but Stefon Diggs OUT with hamstring. Daniels cleared/active.
items.why: Schefter official report; Daniels full go
items.implication: WAS WR corps thinned; Daniels returns to elevate offense
items.opportunity: Terry McLaurin (Q) or others absorb Diggs targets; Deebo/Samuel upside

items.text: Breece Hall OUT for Week 5 (with AD Mitchell).
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining RBs

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final report); Ashton Jeanty QUESTIONABLE. Love ankle maintenance but full-go comments.
items.why: ETR board + Love comments on maintenance
items.implication: Love expected heavy role; Jeanty game-time

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report, no designation for 49ers. D'Andre Swift has no injury designation despite limited practice (hip/knee); Monangai OUT.
items.implication: Evans full go for SF; Swift expected to play lead role with Monangai out
items.opportunity: Swift clear path to high snaps/carries

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection spot after Week 4 usage criticism, but not on injury report and 'full-go'. As of now Love 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week though downside risk remains.
items.why: Usage bounce-back expected post-criticism + clean injury status; accounts for ankle maintenance
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play with lead over handcuff

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt, James).
items.why: Official Chargers injury report via Schefter
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey (Q) and others see boost if active

items.text: Broncos place WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); misses next 4 games, return window Nov 8 vs Panthers. Humphrey promoted.
items.why: Source report from Rapoport; Schefter confirms promotion
items.implication: DEN WR depth chart shift long-term short
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton and remaining WRs more targets

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-factor long-term risks: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy under center, boomer coaching staff (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low 2H targets noted. Still great but stacking risks for later season.
items.why: Knee + shoulder + QB/coaching uncertainty compounding; short-term playable but ROS caution
items.implication: Monitor closely; not pure smash ROS

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs Titans; strong volume/red-zone and matchup.
items.why: Target hog + soft TEN defense + recent production post-hamstring return

items.text: Loves Chase Brown as RB5 @ MIA; workload + Bengals injury cascade (Chase/Higgins Q) boosts him vs soft run D.
items.why: High workload expected; CIN pass injuries funnel more to RB; MIA vulnerable

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts (QB15) vs JAX London (rough stretch, banged line); hates Jordan Addison (WR41) @ NO with injury wrinkle/tough spot; also hates Mark Andrews, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard.
items.why: Hurts efficiency/line issues; Addison usage/injury/matchup; Andrews thin role; Skattebo/Pollard efficiency/game script concerns
